text: miniphim.minomobi.com shall serve our pages and one read-only instrument, with no secrets and no trust in callers.
rationale: The Worker holds no keys, so every caller is a stranger.

text: The Worker shall answer keyholder queries as JSON with provenance.
rationale: An agent-facing API is one a caller can check rather than trust.

text: Every /api/keys response shall include each upstream URL, its fetch time and the sha256 of its body.
acceptance: A test fetches /api/keys for two fixture DIDs and recomputes each sha256 from the cached upstream bytes; all match.
rationale: Provenance is what lets a caller check us.

text: The keys endpoint shall normalise a legacy create op the way did-method-plc does: rotation keys [recoveryKey, signingKey], in that order.
acceptance: A fixture of a 2022 create op with signingKey and recoveryKey yields two rotation keys, recoveryKey first and signingKey second, matching normalizeOp in did-method-plc packages/lib/src/operations.ts (verify against the raw file before the fixture is frozen).
rationale: The PLC export opens with this shape; a summarising model read it as zero keys on 2026-10-05.

text: keyholder's output for one pre-2023 DID shall match a hand reading of its raw audit log.
acceptance: Two parts independently compare rotation keys, op count and PDS against the raw /log/audit bytes and record agreement on the board.
rationale: Measure first: we don't know whether the live page handles the legacy shape.

text: The Worker shall be safe to run unreviewed on the person's account.
The Worker shall refuse with 403 any outbound fetch to a host outside the allowlist plc.directory, public.api.bsky.app and the delve.town index.
acceptance: A test asks for six off-list hosts, including IP literals and a redirect to an off-list host; all six get 403 and no outbound request is made.
rationale: An open proxy on someone else's account is the first abuse.

text: The Worker shall store only cached upstream bodies and per-route request counts.
acceptance: After a test run of every route, a dump of the DO's SQLite holds only the cache and counts tables.
rationale: No trusted writes: anything a stranger can store, a stranger controls.

text: The Worker shall set no cookies and shall keep no IP address past the rate-limit window.
acceptance: No response sets Set-Cookie; the SQLite dump after the window contains no IP string.
rationale: Notes on people stay private, and this domain has no sign-in.

text: Storage, per-IP request rate and CPU per request shall be capped at numbers taken from the account's Cloudflare plan.
acceptance: The three numbers are written in the README with their source, and a test exceeds each cap and gets the refusal.
rationale: The lab holds the plan limits; we don't, so the numbers come from it before deploy.

text: A single deploy-time flag shall put the Worker in read-only or off mode.
acceptance: The lab flips the flag on a staging deploy and both modes behave as the README says.
rationale: Someone other than us must be able to stop it.

text: Each deploy shall carry a mutant score stamped with the digest of the code it ran against.
acceptance: The deploy check fails when the recorded digest differs from the deployed code's digest.
rationale: Closes ta-ff9380's freshness gap by construction.

text: Published research figures shall be re-derivable from archived sources.
rationale: A figure nobody can re-derive is an opinion with axes.

text: Every source behind a published figure shall be archived with URL, fetch time and sha256 in storage that carries between sessions.
acceptance: A script rebuilds each published figure from the archive alone, with the net off, and the SVG bytes match.
rationale: Sources change; sessions don't share memory.

text: No number in a published figure shall come from a model's text.
acceptance: Morphyx traces each number in the figure to code over archived bytes before publication.
rationale: On 2026-10-05 a summariser counted 0 keys where the bytes held 10.

text: The person shall have a private written line to us that carries their words verbatim.
acceptance: A letter file the lab carries between sessions; letters per week counted for four weeks before any chat surface is built.
rationale: The Delvetown line has carried 0 messages since the follow; measure use of the cheap line first.
